paite: Huan Samuel thu Israel mi tengteng lak ah athangkheta hi. Israel mite Philistia mite dou ding in akuankhia uhi. Ebenezer kiang ah panmun akhoh ua, Philistia mite'n Aphek ah panmun akhoh uhi.
heading: Thukhun Bawm Suhsakna

paite: Philistia mite Israel mite na dal ding in ana kiphalh uh. Ahong kidou uleh Philistia mite ma ah Israel mite azahlakta ua, kidouna mun ah sepaih sangli vel athat uhi.

Mipite agiahmun ua ava pai uleh Israel upate'n, "Bangziak in ahia tuni a TOUPA'N Philistia mite ma a hon zahlaksak mahmah? I kiang ua om a i melmate khut a pan hon hondam ding in Shiloh a pan TOUPA thukhun bawm i va la ding uh," achi uhi.
Huchi in mipite'n Shiloh ah mi asawl ua, huai a pan cherubim tung a tu sepaihte' TOUPA thukhun bawm ava la ua; huai ah Pathian thukhun bawm toh Eli tapate nih Hophni leh Phinehas a-om uhi.
Huchi in TOUPA thukhun bawm agiahmun uh ahong tun in, Israel mi tengteng ngaihtak in akikou zuazua ua, lei nangawn athawn ging zuazua hi.
Philistia mite'n akikou husa uh azak un, "Hebrute giahmun a kikou husa gingta zuazua mai bang chihna ahia le?" achi uh. Agiahmun uah TOUPA thukhun bawm ahong tung ahi, chih atheita uhi.
Philistia, "Giahmun ah Pathian ahong hi," achih ziak un mite'n alau uhi. "I tung agik hi! Tuma lam in huchibang a-om ngei ngal kei a, achi uhi.
I tung agik hi! Huai Pathiante khut hattak a pan kua'n ahia hon hondam ding? Huai Pathiante ahi, Aigupta mite gamdai a hipi chiteng a that.
Aw, nou Philistia mite aw, nou sikha ua a-om bang ua nou Hebrute sikha a na omlouhna ding un hattak in om unla, kipasalsak un. Kipasalsak unla sual un," achi uhi.
Huchi in Philistia mite'n asual ua, Israel mite azahlaksak ua, michih apuanin lam chiat uah ataikek uh. Anak thah mahmah ua, Israelte sepaih singthum asi uhi.
Pathian bawm alaksak ua, Eli tapa nih, Hophni leh Phinehas leng athat uhi.
Sepaih lak a Benjamin suan mi khat atai a, apuan khawng kikek nengnung in leh alu a lei kai niaunuau in huai ni mahmah in Shiloh ava tung hi.
heading: Eli Sihna

paite: Ahong tun in, ngai in, Eli in lampi gei a tutna a tu kawm in ana en nilouh a, Pathian bawm ziak in alungtang aling ngal a. Mipa'n khua atun a tanchin agenleh akhomi teng akapkhia uhi.
Eli in akikou husa uh azak in, "Tua thawm ging vengvung bang chihna ahia?" achi hi. Mi khat kintak in ava hoh a, Eli ava hilh hi.
Eli bel kum sawmkua-le-giat a upa ahi a, amit amialta a, khua amu thei nawn kei.
Huai mipa'n Eli kiang ah, "Sepaih lak a pan hong paikhia ka hi. Tuni a sepaih lak a pan hong taikhia ka hi," achi hi. Ama'n, "Ka tapa, bangchibang in thil a-om a oi?" achi hi.

Tanchin hon tunpa'n adawng a, "Israel mite Philistia mite ma ah ataikek ua, mipi lak ah kithahna thupitak a-om lai a, na tapate nih Hophni leh Phinehas leng asi ua, Pathian bawm leng alaksak uh," achi hi.

Huan hichi ahong hi a, Pathian bawm thu agentak in kongpi bul a tutphah a pan athalpuk a, amah tekta a kikhouh zou nawn lou ahih ziak in, angawng akitan a, asita hi. Israel tung ah kum sawmli sung vai ahawm hi.
Amounu, Phinehas zi in nau apai a, neih ahun mahmahta hi. Ama'n Pathian bawm laksak ahih thu leh apu leh apasal si uh ahi chih azak in akunsuk a, nauvei nat in apha a, ta aneita hi.
heading: Phinehas Zi Sihna

paite: Asih dek lai in akiang a dingh numeite'n akiang ah, "Lau ke'n, tapa na neita," achi uhi. Himahleh adawng het kei a, alimsak sam kei hi.
"Thupina in Israel apawtsanta," chi in nau min Ikabod asa hi. Pathian bawm lah alaksakta ua, apa leh apasal lah asita ngal ua.
"Thupina in Israel apawtsanta, Pathian bawm lah alaksakta ngal ua," achi hi.
